meaning: A service that finds web pages when you type words or questions into it.
clues: It keeps a giant list of pages from many different websites, so it can point you to them.
You type words into it, and it lists pages that may answer your question.
It ranks the results so pages that seem more useful appear first.
You often use it through a browser, but it is a different service.
Its name has two words and starts with S.
assumes: A browser opens a page you ask for, but does not keep a list of other sites' pages
A website holds pages from one place
An online encyclopedia holds its own articles, not pages from other websites

decoys.meaning: Software that retrieves and displays web pages.
A group of connected web pages that people can visit online.
An online book with many articles.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. Open a browser, type a question into a search engine, and compare two results before you rely on one.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: We checked an index in a library before walking to the shelf. A list is useful, but you still read the source.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Good habit. Look at who wrote the page and when it was updated.
